title: Mixins follow game code the update moved to another method
text: Mixin breaks sit in half of the blocked mods (2,654 of 5,248 over every update and jump, sweep run 44966973220), and PR #171's trial found them in 83 of the 106 mods still blocked on NeoForge 1.21.1 -> 1.21.2. First measured which mixin break kinds hold mods that nothing else holds: the scoreboard keeps each blocked mod's references by type (held) and why each mixin handler did not follow its target (refused). Then the porter follows a mixin to where the game's own code went, as a method whose parameters changed, so every existing handler conversion applies: a dropped method to the one method the class gained that reads like it; an injection point the method no longer reaches to the one helper it now calls, or new method made of its code, that has the point and is named once in the class; a parameter the new method no longer takes, read from the field the old method stored it in, where only the new constructors store that field.
finish: mods held only by mixin breaks fall over every update, the big updates and the jump to the newest game, with no update lower, and the freed mods start in a real game
wrongIf: a mod this frees fails in a real game on its moved mixin, or a mixin is followed to code that is not the old method's
